query != null and query.jobGroup != null and query.jobGroup != ''

SELECT
FROM sys_job_log job_log WHERE job_log.del_flag = 0
ORDER BY job_log.trigger_time DESC, job_log.id DESC

SELECT , job_log.fire_instance_id, job_log.process_instance_id, job_log.result AS result_summary, job_log.exception_msg AS exception_summary FROM sys_job_log job_log WHERE job_log.id = #{id} AND job_log.del_flag = 0

SELECT job_log.job_name, job_log.job_group, job_log.executor_handler, job_log.trigger_type, job_log.status, job_log.scheduled_fire_time, job_log.trigger_time, job_log.start_time, job_log.end_time, job_log.duration, job_log.retry_count FROM sys_job_log job_log WHERE job_log.del_flag = 0
ORDER BY job_log.trigger_time DESC, job_log.id DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN job_log.status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS success_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN job_log.status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS failed_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN job_log.status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS running_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN job_log.status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS skipped_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN job_log.status = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS accepted_count FROM sys_job_log job_log WHERE job_log.del_flag = 0 AND job_log.trigger_time >= #{windowStart} AND job_log.trigger_time < #{windowEnd}
SELECT job_config_id FROM sys_job_log WHERE id = #{id} AND del_flag = 0

SELECT job_log.id AS execution_id, job_log.job_config_id, job_log.job_name, job_log.job_group, COALESCE(job_log.end_time, job_log.start_time, job_log.trigger_time) AS failure_time, job_log.exception_msg AS exception_summary, job.alarm_enabled, job.alarm_channels, job.alarm_recipient_user_ids, job.alarm_email FROM sys_job_log job_log INNER JOIN sys_job_config job ON job.id = job_log.job_config_id WHERE job_log.id = #{id} AND job_log.status = 0 AND job_log.del_flag = 0 AND job.del_flag = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_job_log SET status = #{status}, result = #{result}, exception_msg = #{exceptionMsg}, retry_count = #{retryCount}, end_time = NOW(), duration = TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, start_time, NOW()) DIV 1000 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 2 AND del_flag = 0

UPDATE sys_job_log SET status = #{status}, result = #{result}, exception_msg = NULL, process_instance_id = #{processInstanceId}, retry_count = #{retryCount}, end_time = NOW(), duration = TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, start_time, NOW()) DIV 1000 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 2 AND del_flag = 0
mapper.delete: DELETE job_log FROM sys_job_log job_log WHERE job_log.status IN (0, 1, 3) AND job_log.trigger_time < #{beforeDate} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_job_api_idempotency idempotency WHERE idempotency.execution_id = job_log.id AND idempotency.expires_at > NOW() AND idempotency.del_flag = 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_job_log SET heartbeat_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 2 AND del_flag = 0

UPDATE sys_job_log SET status = 0, exception_msg = #{exceptionMsg}, end_time = NOW(), duration = CASE WHEN start_time IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, start_time, NOW()) DIV 1000, 0) END WHERE del_flag = 0 AND ( (status = 2 AND COALESCE(heartbeat_time, start_time, trigger_time) < #{cutoff}) OR (status = 4 AND trigger_time < #{cutoff}) )

LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_job_log WHERE id = #{id} AND del_flag = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_job_log SET status = 2, scheduled_fire_time = #{scheduledFireTime}, fire_instance_id = #{fireInstanceId}, start_time = #{startTime}, heartbeat_time = #{startTime}, executor_handler = #{executorHandler}, job_param = #{jobParam} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 4 AND trigger_type = 'OPEN_API' AND del_flag = 0
UPDATE sys_job_log SET status = 0, exception_msg = #{exceptionMsg}, end_time = NOW(), duration = 0 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 4 AND trigger_type = 'OPEN_API' AND del_flag = 0
